# Note
The question is not precise because it assumes a causal relationship between gender and response without accounting for confounding factors (e.g., severity). We will adjust for severity to estimate the true difference in response rates between genders in the treatment arm. This adjustment is critical because the treatment was assigned by clinician judgement and severity is likely to be correlated with both gender and treatment assignment.
